title: Graded transcript corpus pipeline (ingest, dedupe, LLM judge, split, stats, export)
boundary_note: Safety framing = the red team's corpus pipeline for jailbreak attempts (attack success rate per technique, grader rationales exported for the safety eval suite). Mock judge only; every attack/response text is a placeholder such as '[REDACTED ATTEMPT 0004]', so no harmful content exists anywhere.

rubric.desc: config: a boolean override such as export.include_system=false gives False (not bool('false') == True)
config: an unknown key inside a known section of the config file raises ConfigError (not TypeError)
config: load_config never mutates DEFAULTS, so overrides/file values do not leak into later calls
Record.final_pair is the last user turn immediately followed by an assistant turn (a trailing unanswered user turn is skipped, not paired with an earlier reply)
JSONL reader: a record without conversation_id gets conversation_id = record_id (not None)
JSONL reader: list-of-parts content joins all text parts with newlines (not just the first)
JSONL reader: an invalid JSON line raises IngestError with path:line (not a bare JSONDecodeError)
CSV reader: quoted fields with embedded newlines are parsed (reader no longer splits the file into lines first)
CSV reader: messages are ordered by seq numerically (10 after 9, not after 1)
CSV reader converts the 1-based `turn` column to the 0-based turn_index used everywhere else
Markdown reader: the final block of the file is kept (flush at EOF)
Markdown reader: a fence opened with a language tag (```text) protects '### x' lines inside it
Markdown reader merges consecutive same-role blocks into one turn joined by a blank line
normalize: role aliases are matched case-insensitively (Human, USER, Bot)
normalize: system messages are removed from turns but kept in meta['system']
normalize: all documented zero-width characters (U+200B/C/D, U+FEFF) are removed
normalize: Unicode NFKC (not NFC) folds full-width forms and ligatures
normalize: runs of blank lines that contain only whitespace collapse to one paragraph break
normalize refreshes the stale fingerprint, so records differing only in whitespace are exact duplicates in dedupe
shingles: texts shorter than k form one shingle; empty sets no longer give identical MinHash signatures that cluster every short text together
MinHash signatures are identical across processes (stable hash instead of salted built-in hash())
choose_bands uses the documented S-curve threshold (1/b)^(1/r), not (1/r)^(1/b)
near-duplicate confirmation is inclusive: Jaccard >= threshold
UnionFind.find returns the smallest index of the set (union attaches the larger root under the smaller)
exact dedupe keeps the earliest record per fingerprint, not the last (dict last-write-wins)
render_prompt substitutes placeholders in one pass: placeholder strings inside the user/assistant texts are not expanded
judge: max_retries counts retries, so a request is attempted max_retries + 1 times
judge: all retries of a record reuse the same request_id
judge: only TransientJudgeError is retried; JudgeRequestError ends judging after one call with status error
judge cache key includes model and temperature, so a different judge config never gets a stale cached verdict
judgements served from the cache keep their rationale (it was silently dropped from cache entries)
JudgeCache.save / JudgeCache.load implemented (JSON round trip)
judge: error judgements are not cached, so the next call retries the record
parse: line-format verdicts are matched case-insensitively and stored lower-case
parse: verdicts come only from lines starting with VERDICT:, not from 'VERDICT:' quoted inside the rationale
parse: disagreeing VERDICT lines give status ambiguous with verdict None
parse: multi-paragraph rationales are kept whole (not cut at the first blank line)
parse: a JSON reply whose rationale contains braces is parsed (no non-greedy regex cut at the first '}')
parse: a JSON verdict that is null or not a string gives unparseable instead of raising
parse: a verdict that is not one of the two labels gives unparseable, not ok
split units are connected components over shared conversation OR near-duplicate cluster (no leakage across splits)
split assignment is identical across processes (groups iterated in sorted order, not set order)
split fractions that do not sum to 1 raise ValueError
split sizes use largest-remainder rounding with ties to the earlier split (not truncation with the remainder dumped on test)
rate_table excludes non-ok judgements from numerator and denominator and counts them in n_excluded
z_for is two-sided: 0.95 -> 1.96 (not the one-sided 1.645)
Wilson interval half-width is divided by 1 + z^2/n
wilson_interval(0, 0) returns (0.0, 1.0) instead of dividing by zero
bootstrap_rate_ci implemented (seeded percentile bootstrap, ValueError on empty input)
cohen_kappa matches the two judges' judgements by record_id, not list position
cohen_kappa expected agreement uses both judges' marginals (p_a * p_b), not judge A's squared
cohen_kappa is 1.0 when both judges give one identical label everywhere (no division by zero)
the ALL row pools counts (k_all / n_all), not the unweighted mean of per-group rates
export writes every rationale in full (the turn-text truncation was also applied to rationales)
manifest sha256 is the hash of corpus.jsonl's exact bytes (it omitted the trailing newline)
export rows are ordered train, dev, test then record_id (not alphabetical split names)
export of a record without a judgement gives verdict null, status missing (no AttributeError)
truncation marker reports the number of characters removed, not the original length
export.read_corpus implemented (file or directory, ValueError on wrong schema_version)
export includes the system messages (`system` field) when export.include_system
export.verify_export implemented; `cli validate` exits 0 on a valid export and non-zero after tampering
pipeline numbers seq over all sources in config order (it restarted at 0 per source, breaking 'earliest')
manifest n_input counts every ingested record, before unjudgeable records are dropped
cli build passes --set overrides to load_config
